messages.content: Review feedback on the Terraform PR: (1) tag every resource with `team = platform`, (2) don't hard-code the region in main.tf, (3) add descriptions to all variables. Address them.
Done: added `team = platform` to the tags of all 9 resources; main.tf now uses var.region instead of the literal; added descriptions to all 6 variables in variables.tf. terraform validate: success.
The security reviewer says the database security group allows 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0. Restrict it to the VPC CIDR.
Done: the 5432 ingress rule now uses var.vpc_cidr instead of 0.0.0.0/0. terraform validate: success; terraform plan shows 1 resource to change (the security group) and nothing else.

Security re-reviewed and is still blocking: they want port 5432 ingress removed entirely, with database access only through the bastion host. I haven't changed anything yet. Where do things stand, based only on this?

required_facts: The security reviewer is still blocking: restricting 5432 to the VPC CIDR was not enough
The reviewer wants the 5432 ingress rule removed and database access only through the bastion host
